lines: I typed one line — and Claude built me a sleep tracker. No code.
Everyone sleeps. Almost nobody tracks it. Empty chat, one sentence, watch.
In Claude I type one line: build me a sleep tracker with a seven-day strip.
It writes the whole app itself — the time pickers, the maths, the chart.
Last night, ten-thirty to six-thirty. I tap log — eight hours, and my week fills in.
That's Artifacts. Ask for a tool, and Claude builds the working thing.
One line of plain English — and a sleep tracker you'll actually open tomorrow.
